newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - PT Tri Polyta Q2 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - PT Tri Polyta Q2 loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The above figures are in Indonesian Rupiah.

In U.S. dollars, PT Tri Polyta Indonesia Tbk had a Q2 1997 loss of $9.8 million or $0.38 per ADS on sales of $58.9 million and a first half loss of $20.0 million or $0.78 per ADS on sales of $118.4 million.

Q2 net includes pretax foreign exchange translation loss of 7.2 billion rupiahs or $3.0 million vs gain 100 million rupiahs and first half 1997 foreign exchange translation losses of 15.7 billion rupiahs or $6.4 million.

Sales figures and foreign currency translation figures according to Indonesian GAAP. Net and share figures in U.S. GAAP. In Indonesian GAAP, Q2 net loss 26.9 billion rupiahs or 104 rupiahs per share vs profit 15.0 billion or 58 rupiahs per share and first half 1997 net loss 54.5 billion or 212 rupiahs per share.
